qa_pairs.question: What is the weighted average of the proportion of all U.S. adults who favor legal status for immigrants who came to the U.S. illegally as children and oppose expanding the U.S.-Mexico border wall, the proportion of 18 - 49 - year - old Republicans who favor granting permanent legal status to immigrants who came to the U.S. illegally when they were children, and the proportion of Black surveyed who oppose substantially expanding the wall along the U.S.-Mexico border, with weights 0.2, 0.3, and 0.5 respectively? qa_pairs.rationale: The proportion of all U.S. adults who favor legal status for immigrants who came to the U.S. illegally as children and oppose expanding the U.S.-Mexico border wall is 54% (from Chart 2). The proportion of 18 - 49 - year - old Republicans who favor granting permanent legal status to immigrants who came to the U.S. illegally when they were children is 57% (from Chart 3). The proportion of Black surveyed who oppose substantially expanding the wall along the U.S.-Mexico border is 73% (from Chart 4). The weighted average is 54%×0.2 + 57%×0.3 + 73%×0.5 = 10.8%+17.1% + 36.5% = 64.40%.

qa_pairs.rationale: From chart 1, the proportion of Rep/Lean Rep U.S. adults who favor granting permanent legal status to immigrants who came to the U.S. illegally when they were children is 50%, and those who oppose it is 40%. The difference is 50% - 40% = 10%.
